map.水管流量估算器，根据管径、流速与管长估算流量与沿程水头损失，辅助给排水设计。: The pipe flow estimator computes flow and frictional head loss from diameter, velocity and length, supporting water supply and drainage design.
map.选入户管径时，用『截面积×经济流速』得流量，匹配高峰用水需求避免水压不足。: When selecting the inlet pipe diameter, use cross-sectional area x economic velocity to get the flow and match peak demand to avoid low water pressure.
map.排水管按充满度与坡度核算通水能力，防止堵塞回水。: Drainage pipes are sized by fill ratio and slope to check capacity and prevent blockages and backflow.
map.对比 PPR 不同管径的流量差异，选不浪费也不憋水的规格。: Compare flow across PPR pipe diameters and pick a size that neither wastes water nor builds pressure.
map.：DN20 管内径≈21mm，经济流速 1.0m/s\n截面积=π×0.0105:
DN20 with inner diameter about 21mm and economic velocity 1.0m/s
cross-sectional area = pi x 0.0105^2 = about 3.46e-4 sq m
flow = 3.46e-4 x 1.0 = about 0.000346 m3/s = about 1.25 m3/h
map.给水经济流速约 0.8–1.5m/s，过快噪音水锤、过慢易沉积；本工具按你输入计: The economic velocity for water supply is about 0.8-1.5 m/s; too fast causes noise and water hammer, too slow encourages deposits. This tool uses your inputs as given.
map.管径和流量平方关系吗？: Is flow related to the square of the diameter?
map.流量∝管径²（同流速），所以管径加一点流量增很多；选径别卡太紧。: Flow is proportional to diameter squared (at the same velocity), so a slightly larger diameter raises the flow a lot; do not size the pipe too tight.
map.排水和给水算法一样吗？: Is the drainage algorithm the same as the water supply one?
map.不同。排水靠重力与坡度、按充满度算，不加压；本工具给给水模型，排水需另算。: They differ. Drainage relies on gravity and slope and is computed by fill ratio without pressure; this tool models water supply, so drainage must be calculated separately.
